canonical_project: Huawei Baoshan Big Data Center / Baoshan Cloud
notes: People's Daily Yunnan reported Huawei Baoshan Big Data Center had entered operation as an important Huawei enterprise-cloud node and global sample site serving western Yunnan. Xinhua later described Baoshan's unified government cloud, built in 2018, carrying city/county/township government systems and data storage with nearly 70 percent of non-secret self-built information systems migrated.
